entities.summary: Eva Lisec is a Slovenian female basketball player and a member of the Slovene women national basketball team. She started to play basketball in ŽKK Grosuplje when she was 15. From ŽKK Grosuplje she moved to the best Slovene basketball club at the moment ŽKK Cinkarna Celje. In the season 2015/2016 she moved from Celje to the Italian and Euroleague powerhouse Famila Schio. After playing basketball for only five years, at the age of 20, she stepped on the big court- she finished her debut in Euroleague with 10 points and 2 rebounds in only 13 minutes on the court.
